Name: Distant Lands -  A Small Witch Swamp Expansion
Author: Aimon111
Description:
[size=3][center][color=#fff2cc][i][b]Witch Swamp always was an empty place with not so much things to do except fishing and visiting Witch's Hut to turn babies into  pigeons... With this mod I tried my best to change it![/b][/i][/color][/center][/size][font=Arial]
[size=3][center]This mod is aimed to add more endgame content, quests and unlocks, giving player more stuff to play with after they finished Community Centre bundles.[/center][/size]
[/font][font=Arial]
[b][color=#fff2cc][size=3][u]This mod adds:[/u][/size][/color][/b]
[/font][list]
[*][font=Arial][size=3]New NPC - Goblin[/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=3]Dozens of quests and events (including custom quests for [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10671]Alecto The Witch[/url]﻿ mod)[/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=3]4 new fish and 3 Crabpot fish[/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=3]4 new crops and forage[/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=3]6 new cooking and crafting recipes[/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=3]3 new recolors for Witch Swamp map[/size][/font]
[/list]﻿
[center][img]https://imgur.com/4oCmb4w.png[/img][/center][i][center][size=3][i][size=3][/size][/i][/size][/center][/i][center][size=3][i][size=3][font=Arial][b]Meet the Goblin! Yes, it's that Henchman guy you give void mayo to and never see him again. [/b]
His name is Zic and now he fully enjoys his live in Witch Swamp lands...[/font][/size][/i][/size]
[img]https://imgur.com/AyAxiqZ.gif[/img]

More about [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/1792]how to unlock him and his gift taster here![/url]﻿

[img]https://imgur.com/d4lkDJ7.png[/img]﻿
[size=3]
[i][b]This mod adds over 20 new conditional quests and events - befriend Goblin to learn his story and get special items, quests and recipes![/b][/i]
There's also special quest lines for [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10671]Alecto The Witch[/url]﻿ NPC - this isn't necessary but  you may install it to spice up the gameplay and get some more NPC interactions.[/size]

[font=Arial][size=2][size=2][font=Arial][size=2][size=2][font=Arial][size=2][size=2][size=3][b]You can read the [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/1791]list of events here![/url]﻿ (warning for spoilers) [/b]
[/size][/size][/size][/font][/size][/size][/font][/size][/size][/font][/center][font=Arial][size=2][size=2][center][/center][/size][/size][/font][center][font=Arial][size=2][size=2]﻿
[/size][/size][/font][img]https://imgur.com/DQCrciL.png[/img][/center][center][i][b]﻿[size=3]A whole 4 new fish are now available to catch in Witch Swamp waters!
[/size][/b][/i][font=Arial][size=3]Animated fish tank sprites and special rewards for breeding in Fish Pool are supported![/size][/font][/center][size=3][center]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/1793]More about new fish here![/url]﻿[/center]
[/size]
[size=3][center][img]https://imgur.com/lPMTLvb.png[/img][i]﻿
[b]Explore the Witch Swamp lands to find new forage items and discover dark crop experiments in Witch's Gardens![/b][/i][/center][center]There are 2 new forage items and 2 new crops in total - collect them for use in special crafting recipes or just to get more profit from selling.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/1793]More about new crops&forage here![/url]﻿[/center][/size][left][/left][size=3][center]﻿[img]https://imgur.com/flhhkOw.png[/img]﻿
[size=3]
[/size][i][b][font=Arial]There are 4 new food dishes and 1 special crafting recipe - befriend Goblin and finish special quests to get it![/font]
[/b][/i][/center]﻿ [center][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/1793]More about new foods&item recipes here![/url]﻿[/center][size=3][font=Arial][size=2][size=2][font=Arial][size=2][size=2][font=Arial][size=2][size=2]
[/size][/size][/font][/size][/size][/font][/size][/size][/font][/size][/size][size=3][size=3][b][font=Arial][size=2][size=2][font=Arial][size=2][size=2][font=Arial][size=2][size=2][center][img]https://imgur.com/Go3kyUg.png[/img][/center][/size][/size][/font][/size][/size][/font][/size][/size][/font][/b][/size][/size][center][size=3][size=3][b][font=Arial][size=2][size=2][font=Arial][size=2][size=2][font=Arial][size=2][size=2][size=3]﻿[/size][/size][/size][/font][/size][/size][/font][/size][/size][/font][/b][/size][/size][size=3][size=3][b][font=Arial][size=2][size=2][font=Arial][size=2][size=2][font=Arial][size=2][size=2][size=3]All about installation, config and compability plus a quick FAQ about mod and future plans for updates.

[/size][/size][/size][/font][/size][/size][/font][/size][/size][/font][/b][/size][/size][/center][size=3][size=3][font=Arial][size=2][size=2][font=Arial][size=2][size=2][font=Arial][size=2][size=2][size=3][size=3][font=Arial][size=2][size=2][font=Arial][size=2][size=2][font=Arial][size=2][size=2][size=3][size=3][b][font=Arial][size=2][size=2][font=Arial][size=2][size=2][font=Arial][size=2][size=2][size=3][size=3][b][font=Arial][size=2][size=2][font=Arial][size=2][size=2][font=Arial][size=2][size=2][img]https://imgur.com/MkHz46f.png[/img][/size][/size][/font][/size][/size][/font][/size][/size][/font][/b][/size][/size][/size][/size][/font][/size][/size][/font][/size][/size][/font][/b][/size][/size]

[/size][/size][/font][/size][/size][/font][/size][/size][/font][/size][/size][/size][/size][/font][/size][/size][/font][/size][/size][/font][font=Arial][u][b]Why "Distant Lands"? [/b][/u]
[/font][font=Arial][size=2][size=2][font=Arial][size=2][size=2][font=Arial][size=2][size=2][size=3][size=3][font=Arial][size=2][size=2][font=Arial][size=2][size=2][font=Arial][size=2][size=2]
[size=3]﻿Nothing specific with that, I just wanted some memorisable mod name. The name is mainly inspired by Adventure TIme:Distant Lands season. Plus Witch's Swamp is indeed, quite distant.

[u][b]Is this compatible with "Mod_Name"?[/b][/u]
﻿You can find compability section below or ask in comments about specific mods if you aren't sure.

[u][b]Are there bugs?[/b][/u]
﻿Some bugs are indeed exist in my mod, but they won't affect the gameplay that much. The one bug you may encounter is Goblin walking through unpassable tiles sometimes. 

The 2nd issue is increased load times when you enter WitchSwamp map. It only happens if the "Water Overlay" enabled in the config. If you experience extremely long load times, I suggest to turn it off.

The 3rd one - if you use some recolors - the water color in WitchSwamp may be different from my screenshots for this mod. 
There's enabled compatibility option for Better Water 2 mod by default (but you can disable it in my mod's config if you like the colors Better Water gives to witch swamp water)

﻿If you find a bug, please report about it here in comments or in Bugs section with your Smapi Log attached.

[u][b]Future updates?[/b][/u]
﻿I'm planning to add new events, quests and vanilla NPC interactions, maybe even new maps and items...Plus bugfixing of course.

[b][u]Translation to other languages?[/u][/b]
Most likely not, but  if you would like to translate my mod - feel free to make a translation and upload it here on Nexus (upload only translated files and set my mod as dependency).
[/size][/size][/size][/font][/size][/size][/font][/size][/size][/font][/size][/size][/size][/size][/font][/size][/size][/font][/size][/size][/font][b][font=Arial][size=2][size=2][font=Arial][size=2][size=2][font=Arial][size=2][size=2][size=3][size=3][b][font=Arial][size=2][size=2][font=Arial][size=2][size=2][font=Arial][size=2][size=2]

[list=1]
[*][font=Arial][size=3]Install SMAPi, Content Patcher and all other required mods.[/size][/font]

[/size][/font][color=#ffd966][size=4][u]WARNING: [/u][/size][/color][color=#fff2cc][size=4]If SVE is installed, my mod will completely replace SVE Henchman NPC with mine. My mod also restores back vanilla Witch Swamp warps. What does it mean:[/size][/color][list]
[*][size=2]Henchman's hut won't be present in SVE Forbidden Maze map[/size]
[*][size=2]There won't be any SVE Henchman content, events and changes[/size]
[*][size=2]Vanilla WitchSwamp warps will be restored (WitchWarpCave will warp you in Witch Swamp instead of Forbidden Maze - this is configurable option and can be disabled in my mod's config)[/size]
[*][size=2]There still be access to SVE Forbidden Maze map through extra pathway near Zic's campfire (also configurable) so you can still access and explore it.[/size]
[*][size=2]Forbidden Maze map and warps won't be affected, no new content is added in there, except extra pathway to vanilla Witch Swamp map.[/size]
[/list][size=2]
